text: Emotions are a big part of our lives. Every day, we feel happy, sad, angry, or excited about different things. Sometimes we feel afraid or nervous before something new, like a job interview or a wedding. Our family and friends help us understand our emotions. A good relationship is built on trust and love. When you trust someone, you believe they will not hurt you. Friends and family also share their problems with each other, and they support one another when life is hard. Sometimes people argue with someone they love, but a strong relationship can survive an argument if both people forgive each other. It is important to care about how other people feel. If a friend feels sad or lonely, you can comfort them and listen carefully. Many people want a happy marriage, but every relationship needs work. You have to talk, listen, and understand your partner's feelings. When you show that you care and support the people around you, your relationships become stronger. Good emotional health means you can feel your emotions, talk about them, and ask for help when you need it.
